key_insight: The paper shows how to generate graphs whose persistent homology matches a target persistence diagram exactly, rather than only approximately.
engineering_relevance: This enables topology-constrained graph generation for scientific and engineering workflows where strict structural guarantees matter.
method: Local method: iteratively build degree-based PD-equivalent graphs using implicit topological constraints.
Global method: encode exact PD matching as a complete constraint-satisfaction problem solvable with modern CP solvers.
Supports any vertex-based permutation-equivariant filtration and is minimal under degree filtration.
evidence_signal: Experiments on four standard graph generation benchmarks show both proposed methods realize the target persistence diagram exactly.
watch_item: The local approach can trade off diversity and may get trapped in infeasible states, so solver-based scalability and practicality should be checked for larger graphs.
paper_title: Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs
